scripts.dev: npm run build -w @shiplens/contracts && concurrently -k "npm run dev -w @shiplens/contracts" "npm run dev -w @shiplens/backend" "npm run dev -w @shiplens/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @shiplens/contracts && npm run build -w @shiplens/backend && npm run build -w @shiplens/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @shiplens/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @shiplens/contracts && npm run test -w @shiplens/backend
scripts.test:e2e: playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts && playwright test -c e2e/auth.config.ts
